purpose: Persistent, honest outcome record for the regression-baseline scope. A status of NOT VERIFIABLE is not a pass and must not be used as release evidence.
automatedEntryPoint: PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE_PATH=<path-to-playwright>/playwright/index.mjs CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE=<path-to-chromium-executable> bun run verify:yr-003 (set both variables to an installed, compatible Playwright/Chromium runtime before running)

outcomes.behavior: Public leaderboard search trims whitespace and ignores case
outcomes.evidence: Production renderer and bundled public viewer asset exercised by scripts/verify-viewer-audit.mjs with ‘  REMOTE PLAYER  ’.
Browser assertion observes #yr-search-status as ‘1 player match “remote player”.’ after the normalized search.
Browser selects name and observes the deterministic Alpha, Bravo DOM order.

outcomes.behavior: Public reward sorting: Credits low to high
outcomes.evidence: Browser selects cost and observes the deterministic Bravo, Alpha DOM order.

outcomes.behavior: Public reward filtering result announcements (audit A04; follow-up YR-030)
outcomes.evidence: YR-003 deliberately does not assert this as passing or implement YR-030. It remains separately scoped for runtime verification/fix.
Browser disables native share/clipboard before document scripts and observes the rendered status ‘Copy this link: <exact data-share-url>’.
Browser focuses the canonical skip link, activates it with Enter, and observes focus on #main-content.

outcomes.behavior: Public community selector Escape and focus return
outcomes.evidence: Browser opens .viewer-switch, presses Escape, and observes closed state plus focus on its summary.

outcomes.behavior: Public feedback dialog focus and focus return
outcomes.evidence: Browser observes focus in the feedback textarea on open and focus on [data-feedback-open] after close.

scripts/verify-yr-003-dashboard-behaviors.mjs renders canonical DashboardContent and bundled dashboard assets against deterministic in-process authenticated/auth/site fixtures, edits the actual form, invokes the real navigation guard, observes its visible warning, and discards/reloads the saved fixture state.

scripts/verify-yr-003-dashboard-behaviors.mjs sets an out-of-range period end on the canonical dashboard, clicks the actual save control, and observes the rendered error, aria-invalid state, and focus returning to #f_ends without a persistence request.
scripts/verify-yr-003-annual-totals.mjs executes compiled shared pricing API assertions for Pro $240 and Team $690.

scripts/verify-yr-003-dashboard-behaviors.mjs emulates prefers-reduced-motion: reduce in the canonical authenticated dashboard fixture and observes the real in-page navigation call request behavior: auto instead of smooth.

The baseline fixture captures 1-, 2-, and 3-player boards at 320, 390, 768, 1024, and 1440 CSS pixels; two fresh runs must match each other, the approved PNGs in docs/verification/yr-003-screenshots, and docs/verification/yr-003-screenshot-baseline.json.

knownLimitations: The committed visual baseline is runtime-specific. Review and explicitly approve drift after a browser, font, operating-system, or renderer change.
The deterministic fixture exercises authenticated dashboard behavior with injected local dependencies; it is not live-environment authentication, deployment, or database-integration evidence.
